q: How much does an indoor children's playground cost?
a: The price depends on the size of the space, the number of play elements and the materials, so we cannot give it without a brief. We prepare a custom quote for every project. Send us the dimensions of your space and what you expect from the playground, and we will reply with a proposal and a price.

q: How long do manufacture and installation take?
a: The time depends on the size and complexity of the playground. We state the exact date in the quote after surveying the space. The process is always the same: consultation, survey, design and 3D visualisation, manufacture, delivery and installation.

q: How much space do I need for a children's playground?
a: We can adapt a playground to almost any space, so we do not set a minimum area. We design the structure according to the dimensions, ceiling height, entrances, windows and columns, which we measure on site. We also advise on the layout of the playground and seating for parents.

q: Do you build playgrounds abroad too?
a: Yes, we carry out projects outside Slovakia as well. We have built playgrounds in the Czech Republic, Estonia, Romania, France and Italy. If you are planning a playground in another country, write to us and we will agree on the procedure.

q: Do your playgrounds meet safety standards?
a: Yes, our indoor playgrounds meet EN 1176 (playground equipment) and EN 1177 (impact-absorbing surfaces). We wrap the structure in foam and vinyl and enclose the space with nets. We make playgrounds from quality materials with a focus on safety and long service life.

q: Do you carry out playground inspections?
a: Yes, we provide service and annual inspections of indoor playgrounds. We assess playgrounds according to EN 1176 and EN 1177, repair what is needed and replace worn parts. We keep structural tubes, joints, nets and foam in our own stock.

q: Can an old playground be rebuilt instead of buying a new one?
a: Yes, we can rebuild an old playground, most often a Chinese one, into a new, certified one. We reuse steel from the original structure, joints and undamaged modules, so you save money. Replacing elements, changing the layout, a new design and added attractions are agreed according to the condition of the playground.

q: Can a playground be relocated to a new space?
a: Yes, we dismantle the playground, transport it and rebuild it in the new space. We can resize it or extend it along the way. The price depends on the size of the playground and the distance, and we work it out from your enquiry.

q: Will you prepare a floor plan and visualisation before manufacture?
a: Yes, after surveying the space you receive a design and a 3D visualisation. It shows where the slide, ball pit, tunnel or trampoline will be. We adjust the design with you until the elements, colours and budget all fit.

q: Do you also offer inflatable attractions?
a: Yes, we offer inflatable attractions as an addition to playgrounds. Available types and the price depend on your enquiry. Tell us what space and which age group you need them for.

q: What kinds of venues is an indoor playground suitable for?
a: It suits family centres, cafés, pastry shops, hotels, guesthouses, nurseries, education centres, shopping centres and water parks. Parents can relax while the children play, and the venue gives visitors a reason to stay longer.
